Give an atlas built before display existed its display names

Source: R/core_contract.R
migrate_atlas_display.Rd

display holds the source's own name for a region, and an atlas built before the column existed looks as though that name is lost. It is not: label is the source name with a hemisphere affix on it, so the display name is recoverable exactly. Verified against every atlas that already carries the column – 1996 rows, no disagreement.

Usage

migrate_atlas_display(atlas, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

atlas

A ggseg_atlas.

overwrite

Replace an existing display column. Off by default, because an atlas that carries one got it from its source, and the source's own name beats one derived from a key.

Value

atlas, with display in core.

Details

Atlases that already carry display are returned unchanged, so this is safe to run over a whole library.

Examples

atlas <- dk()
atlas$core$display <- NULL
atlas_display(migrate_atlas_display(atlas))[1:3]
#> [1] "bankssts"                "caudalanteriorcingulate"
#> [3] "caudalmiddlefrontal"
